spec_match.rationale: Calls the exact deprecated surface, document.requestStorageAccessFor(origin), and reports granted / denied / removed — the three real outcomes of the Chrome 153 removal rollout.

interactive.rationale: Origin input plus a call button that performs the real API call and renders a live verdict badge.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index card: attempt a real call and track the deprecation timeline across Chrome releases.

edge_cases.rationale: The probe can return false in every direction: absent method, rejection (NotAllowedError observed in the headless run), and pre-rollout grant are all distinct honest states.

conformance.rationale: New v153 feature suite asserts the removal contract plus survivor surfaces; the v152 suite was not touched.

runtime_evidence.rationale: deno task responsive-check v153/deprecate-and-remove-document-requeststorageaccessfor --no-server: desktop OK + mobile OK after final edits; both screenshots read. CDP sweep clicked Call and observed 'denied: requestStorageAccessFor not allowed' with zero console errors/exceptions/failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: The shared demo-telemetry shell captures errors and interaction results on this route; the verdict path renders explicit state for every outcome.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables only (including the amber removed badge via --accent-amber); button hover keeps background+color paired.

accessibility.rationale: The origin input now carries a meaningful accessible name ('Origin to request storage access for' — fixed from the predecessor's junk aria-label); the verdict is rendered as text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness passed both classes; the input/button row wraps on narrow viewports without overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live status output for feature detection probes and async API results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Every form control needs a meaningful accessible name; async results should surface as text, not colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Replaced the predecessor's placeholder-derived aria-label ('Https://embedded.example') with 'Origin to request storage access for'; verdict badges carry uppercase text labels alongside colour.

summary: v153 refile of call-status for the Chrome 153 'Removal of APIs' rollout step. Copy now describes the stepped rollout honestly and the input's accessible name was repaired. Verified via the responsive harness (both classes OK) and a CDP click-through (denied path observed, zero console errors).
